necessary_findings.finding: Sandbox.create(env=...) implicitly creates an anonymous App-owned Secret through SecretGetOrCreate. This violates the explicitly constrained no-new-secret scope.
necessary_findings.minimal_fix: Remove env from Sandbox.create; set these nonsecret process environment variables in the inline worker before importing torch. No image layer is required.
necessary_findings.evidence: Real pinned SDK plus fake stub captured SecretGetOrCreate creation_type=4 and a new secret_id in SandboxCreate definition.

necessary_findings.finding: wait_for(high-level create,180) is not a hard creation deadline: SDK catches cancellation and awaits shield(terminate()). App context exit and client close also sit outside the 120-second cleanup budget. The stated 180+120 controller limits and resource wall-bound timing are therefore not enforced as claimed.
necessary_findings.minimal_fix: Use a single explicit bounded create RPC without the loader scheduling/shield path, and enforce one monotonic deadline for creation and one for all cleanup including App disconnect/client close. Retain unresolved state when those deadlines cannot establish stopping.
necessary_findings.evidence: With real SDK on its synchronizer loop, a 0.01-second wait_for took 0.09068 seconds when fake terminate delayed 0.08 seconds; no real client or network was used.

necessary_findings.finding: The high-level paid create uses the default unary Retry(), so the SDK automatically resends SandboxCreate after transient response loss. It keeps an idempotency key, but still violates this attempt's explicit no-auto-retry condition. max_retries=0 alone does not disable the separate server throttle retry path.
necessary_findings.minimal_fix: Call exactly one SandboxCreate using retry=None with an explicit RPC timeout; never replay an ambiguous create. Read-only discovery and idempotent cleanup are separate from a paid-create replay.
necessary_findings.evidence: Real UnaryUnaryWrapper with a fake direct transport made two calls after one UNAVAILABLE; same idempotency key was retained.

necessary_findings.finding: Native asyncio.run with private raw _Sandbox is incompatible with this pinned SDK hydration: StreamReader constructor asserts that it is on the SDK synchronizer loop. The assertion happens after SandboxCreate has already returned an ID, so it can create paid compute and then fail to obtain a usable handle.
necessary_findings.minimal_fix: Run the whole raw coroutine on the SDK synchronizer loop using synchronizer.create_blocking, or consistently use public .aio objects and the corresponding client; add a real-SDK fake-stub hydration probe.
necessary_findings.evidence: Native-loop real-SDK probe reproduced AssertionError at io_streams.py:573. The same fake-stub create completed on synchronizer.create_blocking(main).

necessary_findings.finding: Modal 1.6.0 defaults sandbox_v2=True. The workflow does not override it, while execute_async rejects True after durable CAS. Thus the default workflow cannot reach its intended GPU probe and consumes a retained reservation for a configuration refusal.
necessary_findings.minimal_fix: Pin MODAL_SANDBOX_V2=0 in this bounded workflow and retain the explicit guard, or choose a fully explicit reviewed v1 path with no default-dependent list routing.
necessary_findings.evidence: uv run --offline --no-project --with modal==1.6.0 evaluated config.get("sandbox_v2") as True without constructing a client.

necessary_findings.finding: An ambiguous create with no returned ID and empty owned Sandbox lists sets owned_sandboxes_stopped=True by vacuous emptiness. A stopped/0-task App row then turns the ledger into failed-stopped even though no exact owned Sandbox identity was observed or terminated. The active-only list plus a point-in-time App row does not establish whether a delayed ambiguous create can still materialize; the attempt should remain unresolved.
necessary_findings.minimal_fix: Track create outcome explicitly and keep an ambiguous create unresolved unless at least one exact owned Sandbox identity is recovered and verified stopped, or separately obtain stronger audited lifecycle evidence. Do not require retries or a second paid attempt.
necessary_findings.evidence: Independent local guard probe reproduced paid_call_started=True, no sandbox_id, stopped_sandboxes={}, resources_verified=True and ledger status failed-stopped.

optional_findings.finding: There is no explicit SIGTERM handler. A forcibly cancelled controller can exit before artifacts or finish CAS; the durable reservation still blocks future registered attempts and server timeout=600 limits the Sandbox. This is fail-closed financially, so no extra cancellation infrastructure is required for this tiny probe.
optional_findings.recommendation: If implementing graceful signal handling, preserve the same hard cleanup deadline and never turn missing evidence into success.

optional_findings.finding: GitHub ledger subprocess calls have no timeout. A stalled read/write can stall the controller; before paid create this cannot start compute, and after stopping it leaves the retained reservation.
optional_findings.recommendation: A bounded transport timeout is useful for operator responsiveness, but is not required to repair this runner's paid lifecycle defects.

accepted_boundaries: P1 workflow remains client-only; the new paid runtime-probe is separate, manual-only and shares the existing same-repo concurrency group.
GitHub contents CAS writes the full USD0.40 reservation before execute_async is entered; failed-CAS test proves execution is not called.
Finance reserve keeps all new bounds plus exact USD4.73 legacy carry and retained official gross increment; no automatic refund or reuse of attempt IDs.
Official App list keys match pinned SDK: App ID, Description, State, Tasks. Missing/running paid App rows fail cleanup verification.

At approved ceilings hourly resource bound is USD1.2758 for L4 + 2 CPU + 8 GiB. 600 seconds rounds to USD0.22 and 300 seconds rounds to USD0.11; other components total USD0.07, giving USD0.40. Current rates must still be fetched and checked immediately before reservation; no current paid/billing API was called for this review.

Existing image is hydrated through ImageFromId; hydrated SDK image bypasses image loading/build. No Volume, build, snapshot or long-lived service is requested. The env Secret violation is separately identified above.

SDK timeout parameter is encoded into server Sandbox.timeout_secs=600 with explicit CPU request=limit=2000 and memory request=limit=8192. Server lifetime is a provider contract, not an independently observed completed run.
Independent audit fixture probes reject self-authoring, missing scope files, hash drift, dirty sources and symlink sources; valid local-only audit fixture is accepted.
Cleanup error produces unresolved when owned Sandbox stop checks are missing, even if official App row is stopped; no charge is released.
